name: Katachi Ergonomics
description: Katachi Ergonomics is a landing theme for a workplace ergonomics consultancy that watches a working desk before it recommends a change. The home page opens on a full-bleed pale documentary photograph with a wide-tracked one-line headline, three hairline observation markers and a white card docked at the lower left; it continues with three equal abutting columns with white arrow tiles, offset photograph rows flush to the viewport edge with an overlapping card and a white notch, a parallax band, a fee table, field notes, the people and one booking band. Hanken Grotesk for headings, Public Sans for reading. Sample content in English. WooCommerce compatible but not required. WCAG AA colours; scroll effects respect reduced motion.
